text:
sam: Quick alignment for the upcoming external pentest. We need a clear minimal canonical evidence package and the retest gating rules.

neha: Minimal package = ndjson logs + manifest.csv (flat rows) + SHA256SUMS + detached .sig. Keep manifest columns flat: file,start_iso,end_iso,service,sha256,exporter_sha,associated_ticket,triage_ref,severity,cvss.

raul: KMS handling: do not expose key ARNs or raw key material. Use envelope encryption and a decrypt-service that streams plaintext over mTLS when presented with a decrypt-session token bound to pt-assessor role. Token TTL = 4h default.

sam: Important: every decrypt-session mint must write an immutable audit event that includes requester, role_snapshot_before, role_snapshot_after, artifact_id, and approval_ids if extended.

neha: We'll require exporter_sha in the manifest so we can reproduce exact export. Also include the export command line in a header line. Timestamps MUST be ISO8601 UTC.

raul: Retest gating: scheduler only accepts tickets labeled `ready-for-retest`. Auto-label when manifest present in ticket body, remediation PR linked, and CI shows two passing runs. If missing, scheduler rejects and comments checklist.

sam: Retest slots: first = +7 days after `ready-for-retest`, second = +21 days. Teams can request earlier or emergency slots but must get 2-step approval (eng-security + infra-oncall) in Slack and append approval IDs to manifest.

neha: Add requirement: teams must attach a small repro sample (repro.sh) and a before/after log snippet (redacted). Put path in manifest field `retest_sample`. This helps assessors validate fixes without full log download.

raul: For integrity: sign the tar.gz with redwood-signing key and include detached .sig in the upload. Also keep a hashed index copy to coldstore monthly (legal hold until 2032).

sam: Automation: when scheduler accepts a ticket it will also snapshot runtime traces and KV cache for the retest window and write them to redwood-immutable with object-lock GOVERNANCE for engagement_end + 30d. We store the snapshot path in manifest as `retest_snapshot`.

neha: Emergency extension flow: assessor posts in #eng-security with justification and tags infra-oncall. If infra-oncall approves within 30m, update manifest with extension entry. If infra-oncall does not respond, escalate to SRE lead. All steps logged.

ops-bot: Reminder: generate manifest_id format pt-<engagement>-<unix>. Attach manifest_id to all uploads.

raul: One more: ephemeral role lifecycle must be audited. Record pre-grant and post-revoke role lists and include `role_snapshot_before` and `role_snapshot_after` in audit entries and manifest.

sam: Action items: Raul implement decrypt-service + audit hooks; Neha draft exporter + manifest template; I'll update the ticket template and scheduler acceptance rules. Dry-run scheduled Tue 2026-06-15 16:00 UTC.

neha: Draft manifest + example command by EOD Fri.

raul: Decrypt-service PoC by next Wed.

sam: I'll add the scheduler acceptance tests to CI.

ops-bot: Engagement "northwind" kickoff 2026-07-01T09:00:00Z. Auto-provision ephemeral roles 30m prior.

sam: Thanks team. Keep dry-run outputs focused and short so assessors can parse them quickly. :white_check_mark:
